mapper.select: SELECT primary_key, self_receiving_detail_code,purchase_contract, receive, receive_staff, receive_time, inspection, inspection_finish_time, batch, enterprise_code FROM ${tableName} WHERE enterprise_code= #{enterpriseCode} AND delete_flag= 'f' AND self_receiving_detail_code = #{selfReceivingDetailCode} AND purchase_contract = #{purchaseContract} ORDER BY receive_time DESC

select t.primary_key as selfReceivingRecordCode, t.receive, t.inspection, t.receive_staff, t.receive_time, t.inspection_finish_time, t.batch, t.enterprise_code, t1.primary_key as selfReceivingDetailCode, t1.purchase_contract as purchaseContract, t1.unity_no as partUnityNo, t1.name, t1.model, t1.material_code, t1.un_modifiable_material_code, t1.contract_quantity, t2.contract_number from ${selfReceivingRecordTableName} t left join ${selfReceivingDetailTableName} t1 on t.self_receiving_detail_code = t1.primary_key left join ${purchaseContractTableName} t2 on t1.purchase_contract = t2.primary_key where t.delete_flag = false and t.enterprise_code = #{currentEnterpriseCode}
and t2.contract_number ilike '%'|| #{requestData.contractNumber} ||'%'
and t1.unity_no like '%'|| #{requestData.partUnityNo} ||'%'
and (t1.name like '%'|| #{requestData.searchName} ||'%' or t1.model like '%'|| #{requestData.searchName} ||'%')
and t.batch like '%'|| #{requestData.batch} ||'%'
${dataScopeParams.dataScope}
order by t.create_time desc

WITH receipt_summary AS (SELECT sd.primary_key, COUNT(sr.primary_key) AS record_count, COALESCE(SUM(sr.receive),0) AS total_received, MAX(sr.create_time) AS latest_receive_time FROM ${selfReceivingDetailTableName} sd INNER JOIN ${selfReceivingRecordTableName} sr ON sr.self_receiving_detail_code = sd.primary_key INNER JOIN ${purchaseContractTableName} pc ON pc.primary_key = sd.purchase_contract WHERE sd.delete_flag = false AND sr.delete_flag = false
and sd.unity_no ilike '%'|| #{requestData.partUnityNo} ||'%'
and (sd.name ilike '%'|| #{requestData.searchName} ||'%' or sd.model ilike '%'|| #{requestData.searchName} ||'%')
and sr.batch like '%'|| #{requestData.batch} ||'%'
${dataScopeParams.dataScope}
GROUP BY sd.primary_key) SELECT pc.contract_number, pc.primary_key as purchaseContractCode, srd.unity_no as partUnityNo, srd.name, srd.model, srd.material_code as materialCode, srd.un_modifiable_material_code as unModifiableMaterialCode, srd.contract_quantity, srd.primary_key as selfReceivingDetailCode, rs.record_count, rs.total_received, rs.latest_receive_time FROM receipt_summary rs INNER JOIN ${selfReceivingDetailTableName} srd ON rs.primary_key = srd.primary_key INNER JOIN ${purchaseContractTableName} pc ON pc.primary_key = srd.purchase_contract WHERE pc.delete_flag = false
and pc.contract_number ilike '%'|| #{requestData.contractNumber} ||'%'
ORDER BY rs.latest_receive_time DESC

WITH contract_receiving_summary AS ( -- 按订单编号汇总产品总数量和已收货数�? SELECT pc.contract_number AS "contractNumber", -- 该订单下的产品总数量：汇总该订单下所有收货明细的 contract_quantity COALESCE(SUM(srd.contract_quantity), 0) AS "totalQuantity", -- 已收货总数量：汇总该订单下所有收货记录的 receive COALESCE(SUM(sr.receive), 0) AS "totalReceived" FROM ${purchaseContractTableName} pc -- 关联收货明细表，获取产品数量 INNER JOIN ${selfReceivingDetailTableName} srd ON pc.primary_key = srd.purchase_contract AND srd.delete_flag = false -- 关联收货记录表，获取已收货数�? LEFT JOIN ${selfReceivingRecordTableName} sr ON sr.self_receiving_detail_code = srd.primary_key AND sr.delete_flag = false WHERE pc.delete_flag = false AND pc.enterprise_code = #{currentEnterpriseCode} -- 按订单编号分�? GROUP BY pc.contract_number ) SELECT -- 订单编号 -- 注意：引�?CTE 中的字段别名时，必须使用双引号保持大小写一�? crs."contractNumber" AS "contractNumber", -- 该订单下的产品总数�? crs."totalQuantity" AS "totalQuantity", -- 已收百分比：已收货总数�?/ 该订单下的产品总数�? CASE WHEN crs."totalQuantity" > 0 THEN ROUND((crs."totalReceived"::numeric / crs."totalQuantity"::numeric * 100)::numeric, 2) ELSE 0 END AS "receivedPercent", -- 未收百分比：100% - 已收百分�? CASE WHEN crs."totalQuantity" > 0 THEN ROUND((100 - (crs."totalReceived"::numeric / crs."totalQuantity"::numeric * 100))::numeric, 2) ELSE 100 END AS "unreceivedPercent" FROM contract_receiving_summary crs -- 按订单编号排�? ORDER BY crs."contractNumber"

select batch, receive, inspection, receive_staff, receive_time from ${selfReceivingRecordTableName} where delete_flag = false and self_receiving_detail_code = #{detailCode} and enterprise_code = #{currentEnterpriseCode} order by create_time desc
